title: Endoscopy & Surgical Video
blurb: Gastrointestinal endoscopy, capsule endoscopy and surgical video datasets, including robot demonstrations.

items.name: Kvasir family (Kvasir v2, Kvasir-SEG, Kvasir-Capsule, HyperKvasir)
items.description: Gastrointestinal endoscopy image and video collections from Norway: 8,000 labelled images (v2), polyp segmentation masks (SEG), 4.7M video-capsule frames (Capsule) and 110,000+ images (HyperKvasir).
items.provider: Simula Research Laboratory / Vestre Viken Hospital
items.access_note: Direct download for research and education.

paper.label: Pogorelov K et al. ACM MMSys 2017

items.name: Nerthus
items.description: 21 colonoscopy videos (5,525 frames) labelled with the Boston Bowel Preparation Scale for bowel-cleansing assessment.

paper.label: Pogorelov K et al. ACM MMSys 2017

items.name: SEE-AI Small Bowel Capsule Endoscopy
items.description: 18,481 small-bowel capsule endoscopy images with bounding-box annotations for lesion detection.

items.name: LEMON
items.description: 4,000+ surgical videos (938 hours) across many procedure types for pretraining surgical video foundation models.
items.access_note: Video list and download scripts on GitHub.

items.name: SurgLaVi
items.description: ~240,000 surgical video clip–caption pairs for surgical vision-language pretraining; the open subset SurgLaVi-β is freely released.

items.name: GR00T-H Surgical Robot Data
items.description: 778 hours of surgical-robot demonstration episodes released with NVIDIA's GR00T-H healthcare robotics model.
items.access_note: Hugging Face account and acceptance of licence terms.
